title: Team Lead, CAE
description:
**Your Job**
As a **Tech Lead for Thermal \& High\-Power Systems** , you will provide hands\-on technical leadership to a multidisciplinary simulation team solving complex thermal challenges across data center, high\-power connectivity, liquid cooling, automotive, and industrial applications.


You will combine deep expertise in thermal engineering and CFD with the ability to guide engineers, establish simulation standards, review complex models, and coordinate critical technical programs. You will play an important role in advancing Virtual Product Qualification by enabling simulation\-led product development, reducing dependence on physical prototypes, and improving the speed and confidence of engineering decisions.
  

**Our Team**


The Global Engineering Services Multiphysics Simulation Group supports Molex businesses worldwide through predictive engineering, simulation, and Virtual Product Qualification. The team works across thermal and CFD, structural mechanics, signal integrity, electromagnetic compatibility, and multiphysics domains, with a strong focus on data center and high\-power applications.
  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Provide technical leadership for complex thermal and CFD simulation programs involving liquid\-cooled cold plates, manifolds, microchannels, heat exchangers, air cooling, immersion cooling, and high\-power connector systems.
* Lead the technical execution of thermal simulation programs for data center product lines such as OSFP, QSFP, co\-packaged optics, power connectors, and backplane systems.
* Review simulation methodologies, assumptions, boundary conditions, mesh strategies, material properties, convergence criteria, and results to ensure physics fidelity and engineering credibility.
* Guide engineers in conjugate heat transfer, thermal resistance modeling, pressure\-drop analysis, flow\-distribution optimization, junction\-temperature prediction, and thermal interface material characterization.
* Serve as a technical mentor to simulation engineers by strengthening their problem\-solving capabilities, engineering judgment, and understanding of thermal and fluid physics.
* Coordinate the technical work of a multidisciplinary simulation team, establish work priorities, remove technical roadblocks, and promote effective collaboration across thermal, structural, SI, and EMC disciplines.
* Establish and continuously improve standards, templates, quality gates, and best practices for thermal and high\-power simulation deliverables.
* Drive validation and correlation of CFD and thermal models against physical test data, while clearly communicating prediction confidence, model limitations, and areas of uncertainty.
* Partner with product, systems, design, and test engineering teams to define simulation requirements and identify thermal risks early in the product development lifecycle.
* Support simulation\-led qualification and NPI programs by balancing technical rigor, product risk, and program timelines.
* Contribute to reduced\-order models, surrogate models, Digital Twins, and AI/ML\-enabled approaches for thermal prediction and real\-time temperature estimation.
* Investigate emerging thermal\-management technologies, including direct liquid cooling, two\-phase cooling, phase\-change materials, and advanced cold\-plate architectures, and assess their relevance to Molex products.
* Communicate complex thermal findings to technical and non\-technical stakeholders through clear recommendations, design insights, and business\-relevant outcomes.
* Demonstrate the value of simulation through prototype reduction, thermal\-risk mitigation, qualification\-cycle compression, design optimization, and NPI cost reduction.
* Promote a team culture grounded in scientific integrity, technical curiosity, constructive challenge, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning from simulation and validation results.

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**  

* Master's or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Sciences, Heat Transfer, Fluid Mechanics, or a closely related engineering discipline, with substantial academic or professional work in thermal or fluid dynamics.
* Ten or more years of engineering experience in thermal analysis, CFD, heat transfer, or multiphysics simulation, including experience providing technical leadership, project leadership, or mentorship to engineers.
* Hands\-on experience using thermal and CFD tools such as Ansys Fluent, Ansys CFX, Simcenter STAR\-CCM\+, or an equivalent commercial simulation platform.
* Experience with high\-power electronic systems involving liquid cooling, cold plates, heat exchangers, thermal interface materials, conjugate heat transfer, electronics cooling, or data center cooling architectures.
* Experience leading technically complex, cross\-functional simulation programs and communicating engineering results, risks, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

**What Will Put You Ahead**  

* Experience with data center products or technologies such as OSFP, QSFP, co\-packaged optics, high\-density connectors, power distribution modules, servers, racks, or system\-level thermal management.
* Knowledge of liquid\-cooling and electronics\-cooling standards or guidelines, including ASHRAE, OCP, and JEDEC.
* Experience with cold\-plate design, microchannel flow, pressure\-drop optimization, flow\-uniformity analysis, or two\-phase thermal\-management technologies.
* Experience conducting electro\-thermal simulation for high\-current connectors, EV charging systems, industrial power distribution, or HPC power\-delivery networks.
* Experience developing reduced\-order thermal models, Digital Twins, surrogate models, Physics\-Informed Neural Networks, or AI/ML\-based thermal prediction methods.
* Experience correlating simulation results with laboratory testing and defining confidence levels or uncertainty bounds for thermal predictions.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, facilitate technical reviews, build reusable engineering knowledge, and improve simulation practices across teams.
* Familiarity with Koch's Principle\-Based Management philosophy or an equivalent principled operating framework.

description:

The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.

  

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever\-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.

 **About the position**

  

The Process Design Engineer – Specialty Operations Infrastructure will be a member of the Process Engineering team at Chevron ENGINE. This role performs hydraulic modeling, transient analysis, and water hammer studies to support Chevron’s Specialty Operations assets and infrastructure projects (brownfield and greenfield), with an emphasis on safe, reliable, and operable process designs. The position supports pipeline integrity, operational reliability, regulatory compliance, project development and asset optimization by developing hydraulic models, evaluating transient scenarios, assessing surge risks, and recommending practical mitigation solutions. The role also encompasses pressure relief system calculations, overpressure protection, and related process safety support.

  

Engineers will work closely with Operations, Pipeline Integrity, Projects/Project Engineering, Process Engineering, Control Systems, Mechanical Engineering, Maintenance, and other discipline engineers to support facility designs, modifications, and ongoing operational needs. The Process Design Engineer (Pipeline Hydraulics) will interface directly with Chevron assets and project teams to provide technical ownership, evaluation support, and remote engineering assistance across the Specialty Operations Infrastructure portfolio.

  

Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, and work hours are aligned to business needs. Standard working hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM or 1:30 PM to 10:30 PM, Monday to Friday. These may evolve based on operational or business requirements.

 **Key responsibilities**

  

* Perform Hydraulic and Transient Analysis – perform transient hydraulic, surge and water hammer analysis for liquid and multiphase pipeline systems. Conduct studies for pipeline startups, shutdowns, valve operations, emergency events, relief events and abnormal conditions. Evaluate transient pressure profiles and identify locations susceptible to overpressure, slack conditions, vapor collapse or excessive negative pressure.
* System Modeling and Data Management – gather, validate and maintain hydraulic model inputs. Develop baseline operating configurations and model various operating scenarios, calibrate and validate models against operating data to ensure accuracy and reliability, maintain current models for operating assets and future projects.
* Develop, review, and maintain hydraulic modeling documentation including relief valve information, equipment datasheets, design basis narratives, control narratives, and other technical documentation as required.
* Surge Mitigation and Risk Reduction – identify potential surge and water hammer hazards, evaluate and recommend mitigation measures. Provide engineering recommendations that improve safety, reliability and operability.
* Regulatory and Compliance Support – ensure compliance with applicable regulations and standards including pipeline pressure management requirements.
* Reporting and Technical Documentation – Develop comprehensive engineering reports documenting assumptions, configurations, scenarios, surge analysis results and mitigation recommendations. Prepare technical presentations and communicate findings to all parties (engineering, operations, leadership, and project stakeholders).
* Ensure designs comply with Chevron engineering standards, applicable industry codes, and regulatory requirements.
* Support development of process design criteria and standard methodologies for Specialty Operations Infrastructure; support Management of Change (MOC) activities with appropriate technical documentation and engineering justification.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

  

* 5\+ years of experience in hydraulic modelling, pipeline engineering, process engineering, or related field supporting crude oil, refined products, NGL, water and multiphase pipeline systems
* Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering (or similar) from an appropriately accredited university.
* Experience performing transient hydraulic, surge or water hammer analysis.
* Knowledge of ASME B31\.4, ASME 31\.8, API RP 1130, and 49 CFR Parts 192 and 195
* Proficiency with process modeling tools such as SPS (Synergi Pipeline Systems), OLGA, and/or industry\-recognized transient calculation methods.
* Familiarity with ASME, API, and other applicable industry codes and standards related to pressure relief and process design.
* Knowledge of core process design deliverables including process design basis, process flow diagrams (PFDs), piping and instrumentation diagrams (P\&IDs), and heat and material balances.
* Knowledge of Chevron or similar corporate engineering standards and management of change (MOC) processes.
* Experience supporting HAZOP, LOPA, MOC, and incident investigation activities.
* Experience with Python, VBA, SQL, or other data analytics tools
* Ability to communicate effectively with operations, project teams, and multiple engineering disciplines.
* Familiarity with data analysis and visualization tools such as PI, SEEQ, or similar platforms.

 **About you**

  

We know our greatest resource is the ingenuity, creativity and innovation of our people. Applications from motivated, talented individuals with a keen interest in the energy industry are encouraged.

description:
WSP has an exciting opportunity for an Environmental Consultant to join our large and growing team of environmental professionals in India. The role will be based within the UK Environmental Management and Assessment (EMA) team, which is part of our wider Planning and Consents business.


The role would suit an enthusiastic individual looking to deliver environmental elements of engineering projects, within a wide range of sectors including transmission \& distribution, rail, highways, energy and commercial / residential, from feasibility through to planning, including detailed design and construction.


You will have responsibility for preparing technical reports, preparing proposals, project delivery, and financial management.


You will be joining a well\-respected and leading global environmental consulting team with a wide range of clients across different markets and sectors including national and local government, industrial, commercial and scientific sectors. You will be integrated into the UK EMA team and will be supported in your professional career development with opportunities for training, mentoring and chartership.


  
The successful applicant would be responsible for many of the following:


* Working with, and coordinating multi\-disciplinary teams to deliver environmental inputs into projects
* Preparing and reviewing written input into technical environmental reports
* Undertaking desk\-based environmental assessments
* Author chapters/report for large scale environmental projects including (EIA, SEA, CEMP, etc.)
* Support the career development of more junior colleagues in the India team
* Supporting senior colleagues with ad\-hoc project tasks
* Monitoring of deliverables/projects against scope, budget and programme

  
Key Competencies / Skills


Essential Skills

* Have an appropriate academic qualification in an environmental, or related discipline (Bachelor's degree or Preferably Master's degree)
* Have about 4 to 6 years’ experience in environmental consultancy, ideally with Environmental Impact Assessment experience
* Are ambitious and appreciate the responsibilities associated with undertaking work in highly technical subject areas
* Have strong communication skills including fluent written and verbal English with report writing skills, such as experience of Environmental Impact Assessment chapter writing
* Have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex technical data and prepare clear reports.
* Should be able to explain and present highly technical subject matters in a way that is logical and understandable – using plain English
* Are a good team worker with excellent and demonstrable attention to detail
* Are confident and highly motivated, with good and proactive communication skills and the ability to work independently, as well as part of a team

* Are willing to help support, mentor junior team members

**What role you will play in our team**
---------------------------------------

  

We are seeking dynamic, creative, and resourceful candidates for our Bengaluru, India location to work on challenging reservoir quality characterization projects in collaboration with multidisciplinary teams of geologists, petrophysicists, geophysicists, and reservoir engineers across ExxonMobil’s global portfolio.


You will apply sedimentological, petrographic, diagenetic, and basin modeling techniques to evaluate reservoir quality, storage capacity, and fluid flow behavior in subsurface formations. The ideal candidate will integrate petrography, core, cuttings, well log, and seismic data to develop robust reservoir quality models that support exploration, development, production, and low\-carbon initiatives such as Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS).

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

  

* Define project objectives, work scopes, and deliverables in collaboration with ExxonMobil’s global Reservoir Quality community and Business Units.
* Analyze sediment properties, depositional facies, textures, and sedimentary structures to reconstruct depositional environments and reservoir evolution.
* Perform thin section descriptions, petrographic analysis, and point counting to identify mineralogy, textures, pore systems, and diagenetic features impacting reservoir quality.
* Evaluate porosity, permeability, and diagenetic controls within sedimentary facies and integrate findings with reservoir performance and production data.
* Conduct 1D basin modeling studies to predict reservoir quality evolution and property changes under varying burial and subsurface conditions.
* Integrate reservoir quality datasets, including cores, cuttings, petrographic data, well logs, and seismic interpretations, to understand structural and stratigraphic controls on reservoir properties.
* Develop and maintain reservoir quality models that characterize heterogeneity and support geological, petrophysical, and reservoir simulation workflows.
* Provide critical reservoir quality insights to optimize well placement, field development planning, and long\-term reservoir management strategies.
* Evaluate, quality check, and interpret petrographic and reservoir quality reports from external laboratories and vendors.
* Collaborate closely with petrophysicists, geophysicists, reservoir engineers, and other geoscience disciplines to build integrated subsurface models.
* Apply reservoir quality workflows and geological characterization methodologies to low\-carbon opportunities, including Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS) projects.
* Support the development, testing, and implementation of new reservoir quality workflows, tools, and technologies to improve efficiency and consistency across projects globally.

-------------

 **Skills and Qualifications**

  

* Master’s degree (or equivalent/higher) with a minimum GPA of 6\.5 or equivalent from a recognized university in Geology, Earth Sciences, Petroleum Geoscience, or related disciplines.
* Minimum 3 years of industry experience in reservoir quality evaluation, sedimentology, petrography, or related subsurface characterization activities supporting upstream oil and gas operations.
* Strong understanding of sedimentary geology, depositional systems, diagenesis, and pore\-network evolution in conventional and unconventional reservoirs.
* Hands\-on experience with core description, petrographic analysis, thin section interpretation, and point counting techniques.
* Experience integrating reservoir quality datasets with well logs, seismic data, and reservoir performance information.
* Working knowledge of basin modeling and reservoir quality prediction workflows.
* Experience using industry\-standard software such as Touchstone, PetroMod or equivalent geological and basin modeling applications.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to synthesize complex geological datasets into actionable reservoir insights.
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary global teams and take ownership of deliverables.
* Experience supporting Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS) projects or other low\-carbon subsurface applications is desirable.
* Knowledge of statistical methods, data analytics, programming, or machine learning is an added advantage.
* Proficiency in English.
